steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In August 2022, Equity Mates introduced Geo Group as a private prison operator, explaining the industry deep dive was prompted after a prominent investor concentrated their portfolio in the stock.

episode.title: Hands down, the most unethical industry deep dive we’ve done

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In August 2022, Equity Mates said Geo Group derived 23% of revenue from the Bureau of Prisons, highlighting its reliance on federal government contracts for demand.

episode.title: Hands down, the most unethical industry deep dive we’ve done

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?
Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In August 2022, Equity Mates noted Geo Group’s share price was down almost 70% over the past five years, which was raised as a reason it had attracted interest.
